anti_overlap: fd-pharmacovigilance-evidence-signal-integrity owns correlated evidence, selective reporting, source completeness, coverage denominators, corrections, withdrawals, and evidentiary revocation.
Do not re-score model quality or debate recommendation thresholds except where an evidence or policy fingerprint must be bound to a publication transaction.
decision_lens: A run is complete only when all ledgers agree on the same policy version, evidence fingerprint, commit, deployment, and final disposition, or when a durable exception state has an automatic recovery path. Prioritize ambiguous or locally terminal states that can strand the only zklw runner, falsely report success, repeat a publication, or leave an unsafe policy live.
focus: Whether every patrol decision reaches one unambiguous, durable, and recoverable state across the automation-run database, local receipt bundle, policy file, local and remote Git, deployment, live API, health projection, and compensating revert.
name: fd-clearing-publication-finality-reconciliation
persona: Review as a clearing-operations engineer who assumes every multi-system handoff can fail after one side records success and before the other does. Build a concrete state-and-reconciliation model for the AgMoDB patrol, then inject crashes, retries, remote races, skipped cron windows, and out-of-order deployments at each settlement boundary.
review_areas: Construct a reconciliation matrix for every externally visible state: automationRuns row, append-only receipt bundle, tracked policy, local HEAD, origin/main, deployment version, live recommendation fingerprint and slugs, health response, and revert commit; identify which record is authoritative at each phase and which mismatches must block or self-heal.

Inject a process death after every side effect boundary, including lease acquisition, database transition, receipt rename, policy replacement, commit creation, push acknowledgement, live-match observation, revert creation, and revert push; verify restart resumes or compensates from durable state without duplicate commits, replaying stale evidence, or declaring a false terminal result.

Examine the push-failure exception path against the existing sync-cron.sh and verify-cron.sh ff-only pulls: prove that a tested local commit left ahead of origin is retried or quarantined automatically rather than causing every later ingestion, patrol, and verifier run to fail on a permanently non-fast-forward worktree.

Test remote and deployment races beyond the repository-local flock: origin/main may advance after local verification, Vercel may deploy commits out of order, and HEAD may no longer equal the patrol commit when live verification fails; require monotonic deployment identity and a safe compensation path that also verifies the revert reached production.

Bind the published result to the evidence actually tested: determine whether policyFingerprint plus selected slugs is sufficient when catalog rows, availability, price, or benchmark evidence can change between evaluation and the live fetch, and require the production receipt to identify the tested commit and evidence snapshot so an ABA match cannot masquerade as settlement.

Audit unattended liveness and durable evidence: a nonblocking shared lock can skip the one daily patrol, cron does not catch up after downtime, and ignored local run bundles disappear with the zklw disk; require explicit deferred states, bounded retry/catch-up, starvation detection, and enough off-process durable receipts to reconcile after host loss without GitHub Actions.
severity_examples: P0: A policy commit reaches production, live verification detects a mismatch, but origin/main advanced meanwhile and the HEAD guard refuses the revert; no alternate compensation path exists, leaving the unsafe recommendation live while the run can only report failure.

P1: A transient push failure leaves the production runner one commit ahead of origin; subsequent sync, patrol, and verifier invocations all use ff-only pull and fail indefinitely, so one recoverable exception silently disables every autonomous freshness path.

P2: The daily patrol loses the shared lock, exits without a durable deferred run, and cron never retries; health notices only after the freshness threshold, creating an avoidable blind window and no evidence of why the run was missed.
source_domain: Securities clearing and settlement, double-entry reconciliation, exception queues, and finality control
success_hints: Demand an explicit persisted state machine with states such as committed-pending-push, pushed-pending-live-verification, verified, revert-pending, reverted, and deferred, plus idempotent transitions.
Add failure-injection coverage for every DB, filesystem, Git, network, and deployment boundary, including restart from each intermediate state.
Require one reconciliation command or scheduled phase that can repair or decisively quarantine every supported mismatch without history rewriting or paid GitHub Actions.
